evidence.name: Screen field: Which section sits in front
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Which section sits in front" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Which section sits in front
sections.description: When two sections overlap, this decides which one shows on top. A higher number wins; the default 0 is fine as long as nothing overlaps. You only need it when you've deliberately layered sections, like a headline placed over a background image, so give the part you want visible the higher number.
